info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Events Ticketing Tickets Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Status Retrieval API allows users to monitor the status of tickets associated with specific events within the ticketing system. This API provides essential information regarding the current state of tickets, enabling event organizers and customers to track their purchases efficiently. Typical consumers include event administrators, ticketing agents, and users checking their ticket statuses. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can ensure smooth operations and better customer engagement in the event management process.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of your tickets. You can use it to monitor changes and keep track of your ticket progress effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of tickets. It is essential to send the correct format as specified in the schema.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operations related to ticket status.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusResponse.title: Status Response

status.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusResponse.description: A schema representing the response structure for the status of tickets.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the ticket.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the ticket was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Details regarding the audit of the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This can be useful for performance monitoring and identifying potential bottlenecks.
